captions.detailed: A three-branch rotary fixture consisting of a vertical black central mast mounted on a circular black base with triangular gussets. Three light-grey hub blocks are clamped onto the mast at staggered heights and spaced 120 degrees apart radially. Each hub supports a dark blue or black horizontal arm, each ending in a unique tool head (a fork, a flat pad, and a circular pad) that can rotate independently about its local hub axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a three-branch rotary fixture. The model should feature a central vertical mast on a circular base with gussets, supporting three light-grey hub blocks clamped at staggered heights and 120-degree radial intervals, with each hub carrying a rotatable horizontal arm ending in a specialized end-effector.
captions.factory: Construct the base part using a cylinder for the main disk and three extruded triangular gussets. Create a vertical cylinder for the mast, capped with a thin cylindrical flange. For each branch, define a hub block by extruding a profile containing a circular clamp collar and an offset arm-support boss. Model the three distinct arms (fork, square pad, and circular pad) as separate links, and connect them to their respective hub blocks using revolute joints centered on the offset boss axes.
